routine.title: Boonta Reborn — bounded engineering cycle
routine.description: Read the canonical ledger and issue #226. Select exactly one eligible task with no active writer or open task PR. Keep its exact task_id, acceptance criteria and target branch. Run one approved Free-tier provider invocation. Open one PR with the exact BOONTA_TASK_ID marker and wait for exact-head GitHub Actions checks. If any provider, quota, identity, lock or validation gate is uncertain, report BLOCKED and stop. Do not merge.
